products.name: Peach Dried Bouquet
products.description: Dried roses, grasses and small white flowers in soft peach paper. It never wilts, so it is a gift that stays for months.

products.name: Blush Rose & Eucalyptus
products.description: Cream and pink roses with eucalyptus and baby's breath, tied with a silk ribbon. Lasts about 7 days in water.

products.name: Lilac Carnation Wrap
products.description: Peach carnations, purple chrysanthemums and lilac sprigs in a grey and cream wrap. Gentle and cheerful.

products.name: Sunset Tulip Bunch
products.description: A big bunch of orange and red tulips in brown kraft paper. Fresh from the market, best in spring.

products.name: Coral Chrysanthemum Bunch
products.description: Bright coral chrysanthemums in white paper. Simple, happy and good value. They last up to 10 days.

products.name: Wild Autumn Bouquet
products.description: A rich, wild bouquet with pampas grass, dusty roses, orange blooms and a deep pink orchid. Made to order.

occasions.label: Birthday
occasions.tip: Happy, bright colors work best. Choose tulips for a fun gift, or roses for someone special.

occasions.label: Anniversary
occasions.tip: Roses say love. Pick soft colors for calm and romantic, or a rich wild bouquet for a big moment.

occasions.label: Thank you
occasions.tip: Keep it simple and warm. A dried bouquet stays for months, so they remember your thanks.

occasions.label: Get well
occasions.tip: Choose cheerful colors and flowers with a light smell. Small bouquets are easy to fit in a hospital room.

occasions.label: Congratulations
occasions.tip: Go bold. Bright colors show you are proud and happy for them.

occasions.label: Sorry
occasions.tip: Soft, calm colors feel gentle. Add a short, honest message on the card.

occasions.label: New home
occasions.tip: Dried flowers are perfect. They need no water and look good for months.
